raw_text: Digital forensics thread on the 'Dubai meeting' images. Ran these through multiple detection pipelines. Results: (1) DIRE model: 0.94 probability synthetic. (2) CNNDetection: 0.91 probability GAN-generated. (3) Frequency domain analysis shows classic GAN spectral peaks at high frequencies. (4) The PolitiMeme app uses a fine-tuned Stable Diffusion XL model for face compositing — their model card is public. These are trivially detectable with modern forensic tools. The real concern is the speed of viral spread before detection.
